title: Music loop
description: Background music that loops: exploration, combat, town, menu. ACE-Step 1.5 (MIT; outputs usable commercially), cut to whole bars and crossfaded so it repeats seamlessly.
prompt_guide: `prompt` is the style: genre, instruments, mood, tempo feel, era - e.g. 'Dark fantasy dungeon exploration, low strings, taiko drums, choir pads, tense and mysterious, cinematic'. Set bpm and keyscale to match. Game music is instrumental by default (lyrics '[Instrumental]'); for a song pass lyrics with [Verse] / [Chorus] tags.

param_help.bpm: tempo; the loop is cut to whole bars at this tempo
param_help.audio_codes: let the planner model write the song structure first: better music, slower; false is quicker
param_help.lm: planner model: qwen_1.7b_ace15 (default) or qwen_4b_ace15 (bigger, optional download)
param_help.candidates: how many takes to generate; the one that best matches the prompt (CLAP) and passes the checks is kept
param_help.trim: cut silence at the start and end
param_help.trim_db: what counts as silence, in dB below the clip's peak
param_help.loop: make the file loop seamlessly (the end is crossfaded into the start)
param_help.max_seconds: cut the result to at most this many seconds
param_help.channels: mono (sounds placed in the 3D world - engines pan them), stereo (UI, ambience, music) or keep
param_help.loudness: integrated loudness target in LUFS; null leaves the level alone. Starting points: SFX -16, UI -16, voice -18, music -18, ambience -24
param_help.peak_db: the peak never goes above this (dBFS); the gain is lowered instead of clipping
param_help.sample_rate: resample to this rate (e.g. 48000); null keeps the model's own rate
param_help.keep_candidates: keep every take in .soundforge/<name>/ next to the result

fast.description: One 30-second take without the structure planner.
